findings.problem: The guard accepts active historical count-weighted PNGs when valid time-fraction metadata remains unchanged. It only checks active image existence/nonempty bytes, without requiring a matching hashed provenance output or rejecting historical count artifacts.
findings.reproduction: In an external temporary package, copied retained event sources and current authority/provenance, changed semantics arms.images to existing historical count PNG paths. validate_profile_conventions returned []. Repository unchanged.
findings.requested_fix: Require every active image to be a current provenance output with exact SHA-256 and byte count, reject paths designated as superseded count artifacts, and add a focused regression case that substitutes a retained count PNG. Where possible bind weighted sidecars or SVGs to recomputed accepted event weights.
findings.resolution: Guard now binds active images and sidecars to provenance hashes/byte counts, checks sidecar PID/GPU/unit, exact source index coverage, frame IDs, raw c weights and recomputed fractions. Targeted stale-image and tampered-image/fraction probes are rejected.

scope_assessment: c/sum(c) correctly cancels a common undocumented base-time unit. Images disclose independent 100% normalization, setup/warmup/timing/correctness scope, descendant CUDA attribution rather than CPU time, overlap rather than wall time, and nonchronological x position. No absolute seconds/ms claims observed.
visual_assessment: Both main images have legible headings and scope disclosures without clipping. Function labels truncate in narrow bars, with full labels in SVG/sidecars. At 400px the previews serve layout/navigation, not full function-label reading.
next_step: No remaining issue from this independent review. Reuse unchanged renderer and visual verdicts.
